description: This file implements the <entity-data> element used in Apache OFBiz's mini-language for entity data operations, including loading and asserting entity data from specified locations.

classes.name: EntityData
classes.description: Implements the <entity-data> element, allowing loading or asserting of entity data from a resource location during mini-language execution.

classes.name: EntityDataFactory
classes.description: Factory class to instantiate EntityData objects from XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the entity data operation, loading or asserting data based on the mode, and handling errors accordingly.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the EntityData object, including its configuration parameters.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate an EntityData object from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the element, 'entity-data'.
